title: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal Unlearning for Medical AI
abstract: arXiv:2512.09867v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used in sensitive domains such as medical AI, where privacy regulations, including HIPAA and GDPR, require the removal of specific individuals' or institutions' data. This motivates machine unlearning, which aims to remove the influence of target data from a trained model. However, existing unlearning benchmarks fail to reflect the hierarchical and multimodal structure of real-world medical data, limiting their ability to properly evaluate unlearning in practice. Therefore, we introduce MedForget, a hierarchy-aware multimodal unlearning benchmark that models data from medical institutions as a nested structure, enabling fine-grained evaluation across retain and forget splits. translated_title: 面向医疗人工智能的层级感知多模态机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在医疗人工智能等敏感领域的应用日益广泛，而包括HIPAA和GDPR在内的隐私法规要求删除特定个人或机构的数据。这催生了机器遗忘技术，其目标是从已训练的模型中移除目标数据的影响。然而，现有的遗忘基准无法反映真实世界医疗数据的层级结构和多模态特性，限制了其正确评估实际遗忘效果的能力。为此，我们提出了MedForget，一个层级感知的多模态遗忘基准，它将来自医疗机构的数据建模为嵌套结构，从而支持在保留集和遗忘集之间进行细粒度评估。实验表明，当前的遗忘方法难以在不降低保留数据效用（以临床相关预测任务上的性能衡量）的情况下，实现有效的层级感知遗忘。
tldr: 该论文提出了MedForget——一个面向医疗AI的层级感知多模态机器遗忘基准，通过将医疗机构数据建模为嵌套结构实现细粒度的遗忘与保留评估，并揭示了现有遗忘方法难以在删除目标数据的同时保持保留数据性能的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MedForget, a hierarchy-aware multimodal unlearning benchmark for medical AI that models institutional data as nested structures for fine-grained retain/forget evaluation, revealing that current unlearning methods struggle to forget target data without degrading retained utility.
